_note: Derived from reading the Group Ironmen Tracker plugin source (christoabrown/group-ironmen-tracker @ 343af95, src/main/java/men/groupiron/), not a live capture. 'body' is what DataManager.submitToApi() would POST: Gson of a map holding 'name' plus only the changed fields. A first POST after logging in with the bank open: every field present. inventory is 28 positional slots and equipment 14 positional slots (EquipmentInventorySlot order), empty slots as 0,0; bank/seed_vault are unordered [id, qty] pairs with placeholders already dropped; rune_pouch is always 4 pairs; quiver 1 pair; potion_storage is [1-dose item id, total doses] pairs; skills is 24 XP values in alphabetical skill order with Sailing last; quests is QuestState ordinals (0 in progress, 1 not started, 2 finished) by sorted quest id (truncated here); diary_vars is 62 varp/varbit values; stats is [hp, max hp, prayer, max prayer, energy, 100, world]; coordinates is [x, y, plane, on_boat]; collection_log_v2 is [id, qty] pairs. Verified against a live capture from the real plugin on 2026-10-17 (77 updates): field names and lengths match (inventory 56, equipment 28, rune_pouch 8, quiver 2, skills 24, quests 213, diary_vars 62, stats 7); empty rune pouch slots are sent as id -1. collection_log_v2 not yet seen live.
